analysis.description: The paper proposes a probabilistic model named RNNLogic to learn logic rules for reasoning on knowledge graphs. It addresses the limitations of large search space and sparse rewards in existing methods by treating logic rules as a latent variable and simultaneously training a rule generator and a reasoning predictor. An EM-based algorithm is developed for optimization, and experiments on four datasets prove the effectiveness of RNNLogic.
